Maya Johal  
Email: maya.johal@cloudoptima.com | Phone: +44 7700 900123 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/maya-johal | Location: London, UK  

Professional Experience  
At CloudOptima Solutions, I lead DevOps initiatives for mid-sized startups, focusing on scalable infrastructure and cost-effective automation. Previously, at InfraMinds Consulting, I designed CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment times by 30% across three client projects. At CloudScale LLC, I transitioned teams from manual to automated workflows, cutting operational errors by 40%. Early in my career at TechNova Inc., I built foundational CI/CD systems that supported rapid feature rollouts for their SaaS platform. My work consistently balances technical depth with practical outcomes, ensuring solutions align with business goals.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Toronto (2016). Thesis: “Optimizing Resource Allocation in Hybrid Cloud Environments,” which explored cost-saving strategies through dynamic scaling. This research influenced later work on cloud cost optimization frameworks.  

Projects  
At CloudOptima, I spearheaded a Kubernetes-based migration for a fintech startup, reducing infrastructure costs by 25% through optimized pod scheduling and auto-scaling. I also led a cloud cost optimization project for a healthcare client, identifying redundant services and implementing tagging strategies that saved £120k annually. At InfraMinds, I developed a unified monitoring dashboard using Prometheus and Grafana, improving incident resolution times by 20% across three clients. A notable project at CloudScale involved refactoring legacy CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, which eliminated manual intervention in 70% of deployment stages.  

Technical Skills  
Jenkins was central to automating deployment workflows at TechNova, where it integrated with Git hooks to trigger builds on code pushes. At CloudScale, I expanded its use to manage multi-environment pipelines, ensuring consistent configurations across staging and production. ArgoCD became the primary tool for application deployment at InfraMinds, where I configured it to enforce GitOps practices, enabling zero-downtime updates for clients. CI/CD pipelines I designed at CloudOptima incorporated both Jenkins and GitHub Actions, allowing teams to choose tools based on project needs while maintaining centralized monitoring. Cloud cost optimization remains a focus, with measurable results from implementing AWS Cost Explorer and custom tagging policies at multiple clients. Docker was foundational in containerizing monolithic applications at TechNova, paving the way for microservices adoption. Monitoring systems like Prometheus and Grafana were central to my work at InfraMinds, where I built dashboards that provided real-time visibility into service health. Terraform played a key role in provisioning infrastructure at CloudScale, with IaC templates standardized across teams. AWS is the core of my practice, where I’ve designed architectures for startups, mentored junior engineers, and implemented cross-team cost-sharing strategies.  

Languages  
English (fluent), French (conversational).  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2021), Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) (2020), Terraform Associate (2019).  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized at CloudOptima for leading the migration to Kubernetes, which improved system reliability by 35%. Nominated for InfraMinds’ Excellence in Automation award for pioneering GitHub Actions integration. Received a peer nomination for fostering knowledge-sharing in AWS best practices at CloudScale.
